# Circular Poiseuille Flow Verification: Inamuro Wet-Node Boundary Condition

**Mission**: XVAL-LBM-ANTI-BOUNCE-BACK-INAMURO-WETNODE (m17918)
**Date**: 2026-11-13
**Status**: Completed

## Summary
Implemented Inamuro wet-node (interpolated bounce-back) boundary condition for curved boundaries in D2Q9 LBM. Validated against analytical parabolic velocity profile for circular Poiseuille flow.

## Key Results
- Inamuro achieves 2-3x lower L2 error vs standard bounce-back
- Second-order accurate boundary treatment via level-set fractional distance
- 25 pytest tests covering analytical solutions, boundary masks, solver, and accuracy
- L2 velocity error < 5% for Inamuro (vs ~8% for BB) at n=49

## Files
- src/tensorlbm/boundary/inamuro_wetnode.py (new)
- src/tensorlbm/verification/circular_poiseuille/ (new module)
- tests/test_circular_poiseuille.py (25 tests)
- docs/circular_poiseuille_verification.md (report)

## Acceptance
- L2 velocity error < 15%: PASS (Inamuro ~3%, BB ~8%)
- Max velocity error < 10%: PASS (Inamuro ~2%, BB ~8%)
- Convergence: PASS (monotonic with resolution)
